purpose: Select exactly one UMLR endpoint using validation classes and episodes only, then compare the locked endpoint with ProtoNet and SimpleShot on disjoint test classes and newly sampled test episodes.
selection_unit: one global endpoint across all dataset-by-shot validation cells
selection_metric: equal-cell mean validation accuracy; each cell is the mean over the validation seeds and 200 episodes per seed
test_access_rule: The selected endpoint must be written to the selection manifest before any test-split run is launched.
